title: V-8 ENG 350 CU IN SPEC HI PERF- FUEL PIPES, PUMP & TCS HOSES
summary: LT1 350 high-performance engine fuel feed: fuel pump (production mounting), the pipe from the pump to a tee near the carburetor, and pipes from the tee to the carburetor inlets; also the TCS (transmission controlled spark) solenoid bracket, held under a carburetor attaching nut, with the production solenoid screwed to it, and the TCS vacuum hoses.

parts.name: PIPE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Fuel pipe assembly – tee to carburetor

parts.name: HOSE
parts.name_expanded: Hose – TCS (transmission controlled spark) vacuum hose

parts.name: PIPE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Fuel pipe assembly – fuel pump to tee

fastening.note: Pipe [3] (triangle 1) runs from the fuel pump [4] up the RH front of the engine to tee [5]; tube nut connections at both ends.
Pipe [1] (triangle 1) connects the tee [5] to the carburetor fuel inlets (callouts at both the LH-front and RH sides of the carburetor).

fastening.to: production TCS solenoid (SOL, box A) and carburetor
fastening.note: Bracket [6] sits under a production carburetor attaching nut (CARB ATCH NUT) on the intake; screw [8] (triangle 2) fastens the production TCS solenoid to the bracket. Tee [5] sits next to the solenoid.
Vacuum hose [2] runs between the carburetor and the TCS solenoid; push-on, no clamp shown.

fastening.to: valve cover area at the solenoid
fastening.note: Hose [7] is shown looped near the solenoid on the LH valve cover; its connection points are not clear.
Fuel pump [4] carries the half-filled circle (assemble same as production); mounting not shown.

notes_internal: Legend triangle numbers 1 and 2 readable at 600 dpi.
Hose [7] pn 3917692 was removed by rev 1 and re-added as item 7 by rev 4; routing/ends of [7] unclear.
Rev 2 mentions an item 9 pipe that is no longer in the callout list (rev 5: 3986350 pipe removed).
Circled revision symbols: 1 and 4 beside item 7; 2, 3, 5, 6 beside the list; 3 and 6 near CARB.
Half-filled circle at [4]; filled-square CARB label = production carburetor. Page stamped K374; C/O 10-22-69.
